automations.help: Things the system does by itself. Turn each one on or off. Everything is written in the activity log.

booking_confirmation.name: Booking confirmation to the guest
booking_confirmation.what: When a booking is confirmed, the guest gets an email with the dates and amount.

deposit_reminder.name: Collect the deposit
deposit_reminder.what: A few hours before a pending booking expires, reception is reminded to collect the deposit.

booking_expired.name: Booking expired
booking_expired.what: When an unpaid booking expires, the person who made it is told.

arrival_reminder.name: Arrival reminder to the guest
arrival_reminder.what: The day before arrival, the guest gets an email with the check-in time.

no_show_suggestion.name: Possible no-show
no_show_suggestion.what: When a guest has not arrived hours after the check-in time, reception is asked to mark a no-show.

welcome_back.name: Welcome back
welcome_back.what: When a returning guest checks in, reception sees how many times they stayed.

guest_birthday.name: Guest birthday
guest_birthday.what: When a guest has a birthday during the stay, reception is told.

blacklist_warning.name: Blacklisted guest
blacklist_warning.what: When a blacklisted guest is booked, the manager is warned.

vip_arrival.name: Long stay arrives
vip_arrival.what: When a guest staying many nights checks in, the manager is told.

cancellation_refund.name: Refund after a cancellation
cancellation_refund.what: When a paid booking is cancelled, the refund waits in Approvals for a manager.

guest_details_missing.name: Guest details missing
guest_details_missing.what: Hours after a quick check-in, the person who checked the guest in is reminded to add the ID and nationality.

shift_start_brief.name: Start of shift brief
shift_start_brief.what: At the start of a shift, the person on duty gets the arrivals, departures and unpaid bills.

checkout_balance_reminder.name: Money owed before check-out
checkout_balance_reminder.what: The day before check-out, reception is told when the guest still owes money.

outstanding_follow_up.name: Follow up money owed
outstanding_follow_up.what: Days after a guest left owing money, the accountant is reminded.

close_cashier_reminder.name: Close the cashier shift
close_cashier_reminder.what: At the end of a shift, the person is reminded to close their cashier shift.

cashier_short.name: Cashier shift short
cashier_short.what: When a cashier shift closes with less cash than expected, the manager is told.

exchange_rate_reminder.name: Today's exchange rates
exchange_rate_reminder.what: If today's exchange rates are not entered by this time, the accountant is reminded.

large_discount.name: Large discount or waived fee
large_discount.what: When a discount or waived fee is above this amount, the manager is told.

void_after_payment.name: Bill voided after payment
void_after_payment.what: When a paid bill is voided, the Hotel Admin is told at once.

transfer_without_reference.name: Transfer without reference
transfer_without_reference.what: When a non-cash payment has no reference number, the person who took it is reminded.

checkout_cleaning.name: Clean after check-out
checkout_cleaning.what: When a guest checks out, housekeeping gets the cleaning task.

room_ready.name: Room ready
room_ready.what: When a room is cleaned and a guest arriving today waits for it, reception is told.

arrival_room_not_ready.name: Room not ready for arrival
arrival_room_not_ready.what: When a guest arrives soon and their room is not ready, housekeeping and reception are told.

long_maintenance.name: Room out of use too long
long_maintenance.what: When a room stays in maintenance for days, the manager is told.

hourly_cleaning.name: Clean after an hourly stay
hourly_cleaning.what: When an hourly stay ends, housekeeping gets the cleaning task.

stayover_not_cleaned.name: Stay-over rooms not cleaned
stayover_not_cleaned.what: If occupied rooms are not cleaned by this time, housekeeping is reminded.

late_for_shift.name: Late for a shift
late_for_shift.what: When someone has not clocked in after the shift started, the manager is told.

understaffed_shift.name: Shift without staff
understaffed_shift.what: When nobody is on tomorrow's shift, the manager is told.

new_device.name: New device sign-in
new_device.what: When staff sign in on a new device, the Hotel Admin is told.

price_up_suggestion.name: Suggest a higher price
price_up_suggestion.what: When a date is almost full, a higher price is suggested for the manager to approve.

price_down_suggestion.name: Suggest a lower price
price_down_suggestion.what: When a date is far below usual, a lower price is suggested for the manager to approve.

target_risk.name: Month below target
target_risk.what: When the month is heading below this share of the target, the Hotel Admin is told.

daily_report.name: Daily report ready
daily_report.what: Every night, managers are told the daily report is ready.

weekly_summary.name: Weekly summary
weekly_summary.what: Every Monday morning, the Hotel Admin gets last week in short.

subscription_reminder.name: Subscription ending
